text:
lauren: quick note from today's remote usability session — a couple participants kept trying to click the image in the sample project card and nothing happened, they didn't realize the whole card is selectable.
sam: heatmap confirms this, the clickable area is basically just the tiny CTA button. let's make the whole card a button or at least increase the hit target.
priyanka: microcopy confusion also: CTA currently reads 'Use' which some people interpreted as 'already in use' rather than 'create from this template'.
emily: ideas: 'Create project', 'Start from template', or 'Open sample' — prefer verbs that imply creation.
lauren: I mocked three variants in Figma: full-card button, CTA-only but larger, and selectable radio overlay. link -> https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/onboard-samples (private)
sam: accessibility issue: when the sample modal opens, keyboard focus stays on the page behind it. tabbing cycles under the overlay.
aria-checker-bot: automated issue: missing aria-modal="true" on #sample-modal; dialog role not set; focus trap absent.
design-bot: suggestion: ensure focus is set to dialog title on open, add visible focus ring compliant with WCAG 2.1, and enlarge touch targets to 44px.
priyanka: checklist UI: current header says 'Step 2 of 3' — screen reader users hear just the number. propose aria-label: 'Setup checklist — step 2 of 3'.
emily: also flag telemetry consent copy — 'Help us improve' reads mandatory. change to 'Share anonymous usage data (optional)' and add a short inline explanation link 'Why we ask'.
lauren: layout question: should the checklist be in the left rail or pinned above the workspace on first-run? testers liked seeing it above the fold on first visit.
sam: engineering note: we can show it top-of-page on first-run using a localStorage flag and send an event 'onboard.checklist_shown=top' so analytics can measure. toggling back to rail on revisit is straightforward.
priyanka: small a11y add: include a 'Skip checklist' link for screen reader users that jumps to main content, and add aria-describedby on helper text for additional context.
emily: acceptance criteria: full keyboard navigation into modal, focus trap confirmed, enlarged hit targets, new CTA copy on cards, telemetry consent explicitly optional, analytics event emitted.
lauren: I'll update the Figma with the selected copy and focus annotations and open a tiny spike ticket for dev to prototype keyboard focus and aria attributes. estimate: 2d build, 1d QA.
sam: plus one — i'll add the analytics event to the ticket and mock the localStorage flag behavior.
priyanka: thanks — i'll also add a quick screen-reader test checklist to the ticket so QA can validate voiceover/nvda flows.
lauren: great, i'll post the final mocks and the QA checklist in the ticket and ping the channel when ready :thumbsup:
